editorial:
Picture a spooky old mansion with a ticking sound hidden in the walls, and you have the perfect setup for this fun family adventure. When ten-year-old Lewis loses his parents, he moves in with his eccentric Uncle Jonathan, who turns out to be a warlock. Soon Lewis is learning magic himself, but his curiosity gets the better of him when he accidentally brings an evil warlock back to life. The movie mixes laughs, scares, and wonder in a way that feels like a spooky bedtime story come to life. Jack Black and Cate Blanchett are a delight as bickering magical neighbors, and their chemistry keeps things lively.

The pacing moves quickly, with plenty of magical set pieces and creepy moments that never get too intense for older kids. Some jokes land better than others, and a few scenes might feel a little scary for very young viewers, but overall it is a crowd-pleaser. If you enjoy fantasy adventures with heart, this one is easy to recommend. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture and sound.
endingExplained: In the final act, Lewis, Jonathan, and Florence confront the resurrected warlock Isaac Izard inside the mansion. Isaac reveals the hidden clock is designed to rewind time and erase humanity. Lewis uses a powerful spell he learned, along with his uncle's help, to stop the clock and defeat Isaac and his wife Selena. With the threat ended, Florence regains her lost magic, and Lewis happily stays with his uncle, finally feeling at home.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves family-friendly fantasy with a spooky edge
